Demo data of sc_data

Source: R/demo.R
demo_sc_data.Rd

Demo data of sc_data.

Usage

demo_sc_data()

Value

A matrix.

Details

sc_data used in dec_celltype must be a matrix object, each column representing a cell, each row representing a gene.

Examples

sc_data_demo <- demo_sc_data()
